legacyMetadata: investigationPoolSize=0 and investigationReuseState=false in the raw harness report are obsolete prototype property values, not the production modes. The application ignores those properties. Some raw workload descriptions say 5000; the actual Sizes and invocation specify 13000 recipes.
scope: Real Spring HTTP, account sessions, coordination, SQL/Flyway and PostgreSQL 17.11. Deterministic proof and ArenaNet fixtures; no live upstream traffic. Windows application process limited to six processors and 2 GiB max heap, with the load client inside that JVM. PostgreSQL runs separately in an isolated Docker container and is outside those limits.
result: All workload diagnostics empty; no HTTP errors. Distinct-account publication and bank markers verified at 1, 2, 5, 10 and 20 concurrent accounts.
limitations: One qualification run, not a paired speedup claim or soak. Mixed-route p95 is not Profit-only/browser p95. Heap includes the load client; Windows RSS is unavailable. Raw no-container wording describes the measured process and does not mean the project lacks Docker support.
